catatan dulu, req adalah request, dan res adalah response, juga yang ku cata request itu data fragmentnya saja kalo  response semua. dan ini di jadiin hex stream
// ========================================
// DPI SETTINGS


// DPI 400:   
request :080700000c040a0a0041000000000000e1
response :1c00a0b9abb38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
// DPI 800:   
req: 080700000c040f0f0037000000000000e1
res: 1c00a0d9d1b38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
// DPI 1600:  
req: 080700000c041f1f0017000000000000e1
res:1c00a0d937b68ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003


// ========================================
// DPI STAGES
// ========================================
// saat melakukan perubahan stages ada 2 request dan 2 response
// dari 1 stages ke 2 Stages: 
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c00606964b38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:08070000020202530000000000000000ed
res2:1c00602920b38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
// dari 2 ke 3 Stages:  
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c00608937ad8ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:08070000020203520000000000000000ed
res2:1c00a0c9abb38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003

//dari 3 ke 1 stages:
req1: 080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c00a08901b38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:08070000020201540000000000000000ed
res2:1c00a0d9d1b38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003



//pengubahan dpi tiap stages(sekarang lagi dinyalain 3 stages jadi ada 3 dpi berbeda)
// dpi 1:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c00a0f960a98ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:080700000c040f0f0037000000000000e1
res2:1c0020491eb98ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003


//dpi 2:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c001060e6b08ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:0807000010040f0f0037000000000000dd
res2:1c00a0d9aeb78ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003

//dpi 3:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c001060e6b08ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:0807000014040f0f0037000000000000d9
res2:1c00a0f97dad8ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003



// ========================================
// DPI LED COLORS di dpi stages 3
// ========================================
// mengubah warna dpi dari merah ke hijau ada terdapat 6 req dan res: 
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c00a019c2b38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:0804000000000000000000000000000049
res2:1c00a0c9abb38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req3:08070000300400ff0056000000000000bd
res3:1c00a0b9e0b28ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
// dpi pertama mengubah warna dari biru ke merah:  
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c00a0396cb28ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:080700002c04ff000056000000000000c1
res2:1c00a089f9b28ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003


//mengubah warna dpi pertama:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c00a0d2c0b38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:080700002c0400ff4016000000000000c1
res2:1c00a0b913b68ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003


//mengubah  warna dpi kedua:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c00a0d2c0b38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:080700003004e3000072000000000000bd
res2:1c00a0c997b38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
// ========================================
// DPI LED EFFECTS
// ========================================

ini posisi aku lagi off ke steady dengan brightness default 6(1-10) dan speed tidak bisa diubah karna harus pake  breathing untuk atur speed, tapi sebaliknya kalo pake breathing brightness gabisa di setting hanya speed aja.:
// off ke steady def 6
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c00a0c9abb38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:080700004c06015496bf045100000000f5
res2:1c00a06973a98ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003

// posisi default 6 ku ubah ke 1:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c00a0b913b68ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:080700004c0601541045045100000000f5
res2:1c00a0e9dcb08ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003


//sekarang posisi brightness 1 ku ubah ke 10:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c006099f7b08ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:080700004c060154ff56045100000000f5
res2:1c00a0399ab38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003


//sekarang lagi di steady di ubah ke breathing dan default speed 4(1-5 semakin banyak semakin cepat)
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c0010509eb08ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:080700004c060253ff56045100000000f5
res2:1c00a0b9abb38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003


//sekarang speed 4 diubah ke 5:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c001060e6b08ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:080700004c060253ff56055000000000f5
res2:1c00a06973a98ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003

//sekarang speed 5 diubah ke 1:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c001060e6b08ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:080700004c060253ff56015400000000f5
res2:1c00a0b91eac8ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003


//sekarang dpi breathing ke off:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c0010509eb08ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:080700004c0200550000000000000000a3
res2:1c00a0d9dcb08ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003


// ========================================
// POLLING RATE (Hz)
// ========================================
//sekarang posisi lagi di 1000hz di ubah ke 125 hz:
req1: 080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1: 1c0060591cb88ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:080700000002084d0000000000000000ef
res2:1c00a06909b38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003

//125 ke 250hz:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c00a0822db28ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:08070000000204510000000000000000ef
res2:1c00a0a956b38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003

//250hz ke 500hz:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c0060591cb88ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:08070000000202530000000000000000ef
res2:1c00a0f977b38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003

//500hz ke 1000hz:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c00607935b68ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:08070000000201540000000000000000ef
res2:1c00a0199ab38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003



// ========================================
// SLEEP TIMER(10s,20s,30s,1m,2-10menit)
// ========================================
 sekarang posisi di 20s di ubah ke 10s:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c00a0c926b08ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:08070000b502015400000000000000003a
res2:1c00a0396cb28ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003

//sekarang di 20s ke 30s:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c00204946b28ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:08070000b502035200000000000000003a
res2:1c00a08901b38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003

//sekarang di 30s ke 1m:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c002079bcb08ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:08070000b502064f00000000000000003a
res2:1c00a0b9abb38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003

//sekarang di 1m ke 2m:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c00208944b28ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:08070000b5020c4900000000000000003a
res2:1c00a02906b08ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003



// ========================================
// DEBOUNCE TIME(0ms - 30ms)
// ========================================

//sekarang lagi di 3ms diubah ke 2ms
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c0060591cb88ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:08070000a9020253000000000000000046
res2:1c00a089f9b28ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003

//sekarang lagi di 2ms diubah ke 3ms
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c0060597cb88ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:08070000a9020352000000000000000046
res2:1c00a01949b38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003



// ========================================
// LIFT-OFF DISTANCE (LOD)
// ========================================

//sekarang lagi di lod 1mm ku ubah ke 2mm:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c00608936b68ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:080700000a0202530000000000000000e5
res2:1c00a0099ab38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003

//sekarang lagi di lod 2mm ku ubah ke 1mm:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c00603931b68ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:080700000a0201540000000000000000e5
res2:1c00a00949b38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003


// ========================================
// MOTION SYNC
// ========================================
sekarang lagi off, ku ubah ke on:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c00a0d2c0b38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:08070000ab020154000000000000000044
res2:1c00a0c913b68ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003

sekarang  lagi on, ku off:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c0010309bae8ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:08070000ab020055000000000000000044
res2:1c00a02906b08ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003



// ========================================
// ANGLE SNAP
// ========================================
// off ke on:
req1:0804000000000000000000000000000049
res1:1c00603931b68ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res2:1c002059c2b38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003

//on ke off:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c0060591cb88ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:08070000af020055000000000000000040
res2:1c00a059c8b28ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003


// ========================================
// RIPPLE CONTROL
// ========================================
// off ke on:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c006099f7b08ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:08070000b102015400000000000000003e
res2:1c00a0795ab38ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003

//on ke off:
req1:080300000000000000000000000000004a
res1:1c0080962cb28ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
req2:08070000b102005500000000000000003e
res2:1c00a0d9dcb08ec6ffff000000000800010100080000020000000003
